record.name: Predictive Sales A.I.
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
PREDICTIVE SALES AI (PSAI)
Predictive Sales AI (PSAI) helps home services contractors capture lead opportunities with homeowners who have a high intent to buy. PSAI enables contractors to respond faster to storms, identify impacted properties, and capture more opportunities when homeowners need repairs most. Built for roofing contractors, exterior remodeling, and interior remodeling professionals, the PSAI mobile app delivers real-time weather intelligence and lead management tools, anytime, anywhere.

STORM INTELLIGENCE BUILT FOR CONTRACTORS
PSAI provides advanced, industry-specific weather intelligence to help contractors stay ahead of storm-driven demand. Users can view historical and forecasted extreme weather activity, including detailed hail and wind swath data with hail sizing down to quarter-inch increments. Define your service areas and receive real-time notifications when qualifying storms occur, so you can act quickly when homeowners are most likely to need service.

PROPERTY-LEVEL TARGETING
Identify homes impacted by hail or wind events and prioritize outreach based on verified storm data. Roofing and remodeling companies can focus marketing and sales efforts on the right properties at the right time, improving efficiency and response speed after storms.

CAPTURE AND MANAGE MORE OPPORTUNITIES
PSAI supports lead capture and customer engagement with tools designed for busy teams:
- AI Call Center Agent that answers inbound calls, schedules appointments, and syncs with built-in calendar functionality
- Integrated lead capture forms including AI Chatbots and an AI Roofing Calculator
- Centralized communication portal with homeowners
These features help ensure opportunities are captured and managed even after hours or during peak demand.

TRUSTED BY ROOFING PROFESSIONALS AND GAF PARTNERS
PSAI is widely used by roofing contractors, including many affiliated with GAF. The app also supports GAF WeatherHub, a co-branded PSAI solution that enables GAF-certified contractors to identify when homes with GAF warranties are impacted by hailstorms and proactively reach out to homeowners for free inspections and estimates.

ACCOUNT REQUIRED
This app is free for existing PSAI and GAF WeatherHub users and requires an active account. The PSAI mobile app is designed as a companion to the PSAI desktop platform.

record.name: RepIQ: Sales Trainer
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
RepIQ is your AI-powered sales role-play partner. Practice the conversations that actually close deals—objection handling, the walkaround, F&I, follow-up calls—and get instant, specific coaching on every response.

Built for automotive sales and service professionals, RepIQ turns downtime into reps. Run a quick guided drill between customers, or jump into a full voice role-play that feels like the real thing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Role-Play Mode — Hold a natural back-and-forth with an AI customer by voice or text. They push back, stall, and object just like a real buyer.
• Guided Mode — Work through objections one decision at a time, with multiple-choice responses and instant explanations of why each one works.
• Real Scenarios — Practice the situations you face every day: price objections, trade-in pushback, "I'm just looking," service upsells, F&I, be-backs, and more.
• Instant Coaching — Get scored feedback so you know exactly what to tighten before the next customer.

WHY REPIQ
• Practice without the pressure—or the lost deal.
• Build muscle memory for tough objections.
• Short sessions that fit between customers.
• Coaching that's specific, not generic.

Whether you're new on the floor or a seasoned closer keeping your edge, RepIQ helps you walk into every conversation ready.

RepIQ is provided through your dealership or organization. Sign in with the account your team provides.

record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
CloudForge is the field companion to the CloudForge sales platform. It is built for the
part of the job that happens away from a desk — in the truck, in a parking lot, outside
a plant that may or may not be expecting you.

FIND WHO TO CALL ON
Search the prospecting map by area, by industry, by company size, or by asking in plain
language. Filter by region or state, or draw a radius around where you are standing.
Every pin shows where a company sits in your pipeline before you tap it.

PLAN THE DAY

it is still fresh.

WORK THE CRM FROM ANYWHERE
Company profiles with contacts, notes, tasks, visit history and correspondence. Change a
status, add a contact, log a call, complete a follow-up. Changes appear everywhere they
should, on this device and on the web.

STAY ON TOP OF WHAT CAME IN
One place for notifications, tasks and every email, call and visit logged against your
account. Open an email thread and reply from your phone, with AI help drafting or
adjusting the tone if you want it.

CAMPAIGNS AND OUTREACH
Pause, resume or cancel an email, call or combined campaign when it needs attention.
Review AI-sourced leads and AI-drafted outreach before anything is sent — nothing goes
out without a person approving it.

CloudForge requires an existing CloudForge account. It is not a standalone product.

record.name: RolePractice.ai
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
RolePractice.ai turns every sales rep into a confident closer. Practice realistic sales calls with lifelike AI buyers, then get instant, objective scoring and coaching on the exact skills that move deals forward.

Stop winging it on live calls. Rehearse discovery, objection handling, demos, negotiation, and closing against AI buyers who push back, ask hard questions, and behave like the real thing, as many times as you want, judgment-free.

HOW IT WORKS
- Set the scene: choose a scenario, your role, the buyer persona, and difficulty from Easy to Expert.
- Shape the buyer: tune their personality with the DISC dial, from warm and easygoing to direct and demanding.
- Make the call: talk naturally with your voice and the AI buyer responds in real time.
- Get scored: receive an instant scorecard across 10 core selling categories, plus a focused tip for your next call.
- Improve: track your scores, streaks, and progress over time.

WHAT YOU CAN PRACTICE
- Discovery and needs analysis
- Objection handling
- Value articulation and positioning
- Cold calls and openers
- Product demos
- Pricing and negotiation
- Closing and next steps

FEATURES
- Lifelike, voice-based AI buyers that react like real prospects
- 10-category scorecard with actionable coaching after every call
- Adjustable difficulty and DISC-based buyer personalities
- Hands-Free Mode for practicing on the go, fully voice-driven
- Spoken coach recap so you can review with your eyes off the screen
- Team leaderboards, streaks, and badges to keep everyone sharp
- Manager view to track team activity and progress

BUILT FOR SALES TEAMS
Whether you are an SDR making your first cold calls, an AE running discovery, or a manager ramping new reps, RolePractice.ai gives your team a safe place to practice, fail, and get better before it costs a real deal.

RolePractice.ai is a companion app that works with your RolePractice.ai account.

record.name: SalesCoach AI: Close Deals
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Train like a top closer — anytime, no partner needed.

SalesCoach is your AI sales coach in your pocket. Practice real objections against lifelike AI buyers, record your real sales calls for instant structured notes, and get a graded scorecard after every conversation so you know exactly what to sharpen next.

WHY REPS USE SALESCOACH
Talent isn't enough. Reps who drill get better. SalesCoach gives you the reps — the practice, the feedback, and the tracking — without booking a manager's time or waiting for the next 1:1.

AI ROLEPLAY ON DEMAND
Jump into a live, hands-free voice call with a realistic AI buyer. Discovery, pricing pushback, "I need to think about it," the competitor comparison — practice the moments that actually lose deals. Scenarios adapt to your industry, your product, and the language you sell in.

LIVE-CALL NOTETAKER
Record real sales meetings and get clean, structured notes in minutes — key points, objections raised, action items, and next steps. Stop scribbling during calls. Stay present, close better, and let SalesCoach capture the details.

A SCORECARD AFTER EVERY CALL
Every roleplay and recorded call is graded across the skills that move deals: discovery, objection handling, closing, and rapport. See your strengths, your gaps, and your trend over time — so improvement is measurable, not a guess.

ASK YOUR COACH ANYTHING
Stuck on a tough prospect or a specific objection? Ask your AI coach for a framework, a rebuttal, or a script — tailored to your deal, on the spot.

HOME-SCREEN WIDGETS
One-tap record and a daily objection drill, right from your home screen. Build the habit without opening the app.

BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU SELL
- Personalized to your industry, product, and role (rep or manager)
- Practice in the language you close in — English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi and more
- Training Hub with focused drills for the skills you want to level up

WHO IT'S FOR
Account executives, SDRs and BDRs, field sales, real estate, insurance, automotive, SaaS — anyone who lives and dies by the close and wants a faster way to get better.

Practice daily. Watch your close rate climb.

PLANS AND WHAT THEY INCLUDE
Practice minutes (live roleplay calls) and call review minutes (recorded or uploaded real calls, transcribed and graded) are counted separately, and both reset at the start of every month.

- Free: 15 practice minutes and 60 call review minutes per month.
- Pro — $34.99/month or $349/year: 100 practice minutes and 300 call review minutes per month.
- Ultra — $59.99/month or $599/year: 200 practice minutes and 600 call review minutes per month.

Pro and Ultra include exactly the same features. The only difference is how many minutes a month you get. Unused minutes do not carry over.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://salescoachapp.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://salescoachapp.vercel.app/privacy

record.name: James - AI Sales Meeting Coach
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
James puts thousands of conversations to work for you.

You know those little patterns that set apart the top performers from everyone else? We found them. And now James shares that knowledge with you without you lifting a finger - before every conversation, after every call, day in, day out.

Before you walk in, James has already briefed you. By the time you're done, he's drafted the follow-up. And that night, James coaches you through the real data that makes you a little sharper the next day.

Learn from your best meetings and repeat them.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Record the meeting, in person or on a call. No bot joins in.
2. Get your notes, your summary, and every decision and to-do, pulled out and titled.
3. Get coached the moment you hang up, then walk into the next meeting already briefed.

MEETING NOTES, WRITTEN FOR YOU
Stay in the conversation instead of scribbling through it. James writes the summary, titles the decisions, and lists the to-dos. Nothing said in the room is lost by the time you follow up.

MEETING PREP: HOW TO APPROACH THIS PERSON
James reads everyone you meet from how they actually talk, then hands you the plan before you walk in.
- Where they sit on the DISC map, and what that changes. DISC is a plain read of how someone decides: fast or careful, task-first or people-first.
- What drives them, built from your own past meetings.


COACHING THE SECOND YOU HANG UP
- The exact moment it slipped, with the timestamp. And the moment it went right.
- One win and one fix, every time.
- Your delivery read: how you came across. Pace, energy, hedging, and those trailing endings.
- A Presence Score, filler and pace against your own baseline.

Learning  COMPOUNDS
James tracks every trait across meetings, so you can watch yourself get better instead of guessing. Each one gets tagged consistent, emerging, or new, so you know what's sticking. The behavior that won last week's deal becomes the one you run by default.

REAL MEETINGS, NOT ROLE PLAY
A role play with a colleague who already likes you won't tell you much. Neither will a course you finish and never open again. James coaches the real thing: the messy discovery meeting, the hard price question, the follow-up you almost fumbled. No manager reviews you.


Pros review their game film. Now you can.

Requires iPhone on iOS 26.2 or later.

AI Sales POS is a business monitoring and management application designed for entrepreneurs, store owners, and companies that want to track their financial activity and business performance in real time.

AI Sales POS helps business owners stay informed about their operations even when they are away from their store.

After creating an account and verifying their business profile, users can access different sections of the application to monitor and manage their business activity.

Product Management

Expense Tracking

Tracking expenses helps businesses maintain better financial control and visibility over their spending.

• Retail stores
• Small shops
• Entrepreneurs managing business finances

AI Sales POS is continuously evolving.
Future updates aim to expand the platform with additional features that will allow businesses to manage more operational processes directly from mobile devices.

Our goal is to provide entrepreneurs with a reliable and easy-to-use business tool that helps them monitor and understand their business performance anytime and anywhere.

record.description_evidence:
You only get one shot at the call that matters. Practice it first.
GoldCall lets you have a real, spoken sales call with an AI that plays your prospect, then scores how you did and shows you the exact lines you could have said better. Do it again tomorrow and watch your scores climb.

HOW IT WORKS
Pick what you want to work on, talk it out loud, and get scored in seconds.

Practice. Cold call an AI lead, run a specific scenario, or leave a voicemail.
Talk. The AI answers in real time and stays fully in character, pushback and all.
Get scored. An AI coach grades you on five sales skills, writes a clear summary, and flags the moments you could improve.
Track. Every take is saved so you can see yourself getting better over time.

PRACTICE REAL SITUATIONS
Cold calling against AI leads with real personalities, from busy and guarded to friendly and price focused
Scenarios for discovery, objections, negotiation, closing, and getting past gatekeepers
Voicemail practice with instant feedback on your hook, your message, and your call to action
Set the difficulty from easy to brutal and feel the pressure of a real call

FEEDBACK THAT ACTUALLY HELPS
An overall score plus a breakdown across five sales skills
What went well and what to work on, in plain language
The best part: for the exact moment you fumbled, see what you said and the stronger line to say instead
A full transcript of every call so nothing slips through

BUILT FOR SALESPEOPLE
Whether you are an SDR making your first cold calls, an account executive sharpening discovery, or a founder selling your own product, GoldCall meets you where you are. Practice on your own time, with no awkward roleplay partner and no one judging you.

FOR SALES TEAMS
Managers can create a team, invite their reps, and follow everyone's practice and scores from the web. Reps keep their personal practice private and only share what they do in the team workspace.

Stop practicing on real prospects. Get good in GoldCall first.

GoldCall requires a GoldCall Pro subscription to access its features. GoldCall Pro is available as an auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly ($19.99/month) or yearly ($149.99/year). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings

record.name: Vendwa: AI Sales Agent
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
It is 9pm. A customer asks "last price?" and you are tired. Vendwa answers, negotiates, and takes the order — on your shop's own number.

You know how it goes. Customers message at night, ask for last price at dawn, and go quiet when you take an hour to reply. You lose sales not because your goods are poor, but because you cannot be in every chat at once. Vendwa can.

Vendwa is an AI sales agent for small shops. It talks to customers the way you would: answers their questions, holds your price line, agrees a fair amount, and writes the order down with the exact total. You set the lowest price you can accept. Vendwa never goes below it.

This app is your window into the shop. Open it to see every order, every conversation, and every cedi.

WHAT THE APP DOES
- See new orders the moment the AI records them
- Mark orders paid or delivered with one tap
- Read every conversation your AI is handling, live
- Take over any chat when you want to talk yourself
- Whisper private instructions mid-chat — the customer never sees them
- Get an alert on your phone when an order comes in or a customer needs you

HOW VENDWA SELLS FOR YOU
- Answers customers 24/7 — even when you are asleep or at the market
- Negotiates within the price floors you set, never below your number
- Records each order with the exact amount agreed
- Sends your MoMo payment details and a receipt when the customer pays
- Offers pay-on-delivery or deposit, if you allow it
- Follows up politely with customers who went quiet

MADE FOR GHANA'S SELLERS
Vendwa was built for Ghana's shops — fashion sellers, boutiques, online vendors. It understands negotiation, because your customers expect it. It understands MoMo, because that is how they pay. Prices are in cedis. Nothing to translate, nothing to work around.

BUILT FOR REAL SHOPS
- Catalog with photos — a customer asks, Vendwa shows the item and the price
- Switch between your shops in one tap
- Give your sister or your shop assistant a seat — everyone sees the same orders
- Analytics that matter: your best sellers and your revenue, week by week

YOU STAY THE BOSS
Vendwa hides nothing from you. Every message the AI sends is in the app for you to read. Step into any chat and the AI goes quiet until you hand it back. Change a price floor and the AI follows it from the next message.

Vendwa works on the messaging apps your customers already use. Connect your WhatsApp Business number once, and Vendwa replies there as your shop — customers see your name and your number.

Questions? Email support@vendwa.com — a real person will answer you.

record.name: Lora — AI Sales Agent
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Lora is the AI sales agent that runs your customer conversations on WhatsApp — answering questions, taking orders, and collecting payments 24/7, so you never miss a sale, even while you sleep.

Built for small business owners who sell through chat, Lora handles the busywork of selling so you can focus on running your business.

MEET LORA, YOUR AI SALES AGENT
• Replies instantly to every customer message, day or night
• Answers product questions using your real catalog, prices, and stock
• Takes orders and records delivery details automatically
• Shares your payment options and confirms payments
• Escalates to you whenever a human touch is needed

RUN YOUR WHOLE BUSINESS FROM ONE APP
• Orders — accept, reject, and fulfill orders with full customer and delivery details
• Products — manage your catalog with photos, prices, categories, and low-stock alerts
• Customers — see every customer's orders, spend, and chat history in one place
• Analytics — track revenue, order volume, top products, and conversion rates
• Delivery — charge a fixed fee, price by area, offer free delivery, or confirm manually
• Payments — set up bank transfer and mobile money collection options
• Team — invite teammates and set your operating hours

TEST AND TUNE IN LORA STUDIO
Ask Lora questions about your business, or simulate customer conversations to see exactly how she responds before customers do.

ALWAYS IN CONTROL
Pause Lora's auto-replies for your whole business or a single conversation and take over anytime. Real-time push notifications keep you on top of new orders, payments, and chats.

GET SET UP IN MINUTES
Create your business profile, add products, connect a WhatsApp line, and share your link — Lora starts selling right away.

Lora never goes offline. She takes the order — you take the win.

record.name: KnockLab AI: D2D Sales Coach
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Practice the door before you knock.

KnockLab is an AI practice coach for door-to-door sales reps. Pick a homeowner, deliver your opener, handle the pushback, and get honest feedback before you hit your turf.

THREE HOMEOWNERS, THREE CHALLENGES
- Dolores: friendly and chatty, but never decides at the door
- Mike: busy dad, wants you gone in 30 seconds
- Travis: "Can't you read the sign?"
Each homeowner has a hidden motive. Ask the right questions and they open up. Push too hard and the door closes.

SPEAK OR TYPE
Practice out loud with voice, or run quick text reps on the go.

A SCORECARD THAT QUOTES YOU
- Letter grade plus scores for opener, rapport, objection handling and closing
- The exact line where you lost them, and why
- The line a top closer would have said instead
- Whether you uncovered the hidden motive

BUILT FOR YOUR OFFER
Solar, pest control, roofing, security, fiber internet or home services. Your homeowners react to what you actually sell.

DAILY PRE-SHIFT WARMUP
Three quick objections before your shift, graded, with a streak to keep you sharp. Plus 10-second opener drills.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
See your average grade, how often you uncover the hidden motive, and your weakest skill.

Homeowners in KnockLab are AI characters. No account needed.

SUBSCRIPTION
KnockLab Pro unlocks all roleplays, scorecards, warmups and drills. Start with a free trial on the yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.knocklab.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.knocklab.app/privacy
